newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Children die playing with grenade in Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Children die playing with grenade in Philippines.

text.p: Four children were killed in the central Philippines on Monday when a grenade one of them found and tried to chop up exploded, police said.
They said Rubico Piazita, 16, took out a machete and tried to cut the grenade into pieces when it went off, killing his two brothers aged 12 and 2, and a sister, aged 6.
Their parents were away when the explosion occurred in the mountain town of Sagay, near Bacolod.

It was the second incident involving a grenade to occur in the town in five days. A man last week threw a grenade at a village dance in another part of the town, wounding 19 people. Police said the incident was triggered by a quarrel involving the man and some of the guests. The attacker was still at large.
